[decision] decision.engine-language-typescript — Engine language: TypeScript, not Rust (status: todo, access: 0)
    DECISION: Build the video engine in TypeScript (Bun/Node), NOT Rust.
ROOT CAUSE: Remotion + Hyperframes render via headless Chrome + ffmpeg — both are Node-locked with NO Rust rendering API. Rust could only shell out to their CLIs.
EVIDENCE: 95%+ of render wall-clock is Chrome frame-capture + ffmpeg encode (language-agnostic). JS orchestration is <5%. Remotion shipped a Rust binary internally for small tasks but the renderer still needs Node.
BINARY: ship via 'bun build --compile' (single executable) with ffmpeg as a system dep — you cannot bundle Chrome+ffmpeg into a binary in 2026.
SPLIT THAT HOLDS: Rust for the Kavach harness (gates/RPC/SurrealDB — concurrent, correctness-critical, long-lived); TypeScript for the video renderer (Chrome-bound).
SOURCES: remotion.dev/docs/ssr-node, github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes, remotion.dev/blog/4-0, bun.com/docs/bundler/executables, github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/issues/4949
[decision] decision.linter-language-typescript — Video linter stays TypeScript, not Rust/WASM (status: todo, access: 0)
    DECISION: The composition linter/validator (interval-overlap, AABB, IoU, bounds, grid auto-layout, WCAG contrast) stays in TypeScript — same runtime as the spec. NOT Rust+WASM/napi.
WHY: linter runs ONCE per render on 10-60 elements; worst-case O(n^2) ~3600 AABB pairs = <1ms in V8. A Rust+WASM boundary adds ~15ms serialization (swamps the <1ms compute); napi-rs adds 1-12x overhead on light calls.
EVIDENCE: OpenUI rewrote a Rust+WASM parser BACK to TypeScript for 3x speedup (boundary serialization dominated). ScyllaDB napi-rs addon was 12x slower than pure Rust on light calls before heavy opt. taffy (Rust grid engine) is mature but overkill — we need ~30 lines of grid math, not a layout renderer.
AI-AUTHORING: keeping validator in TS = single-language self-correct loop (TS spec -> TS validator -> TS fix), which the LLM authoring workflow needs.
SOURCES: openui.com/blog/rust-wasm-parser, scylladb.com/2026/02/11 napi-rs case study, github.com/DioxusLabs/taffy, 0fps.net collision benchmarks
[decision] decision.hybrid-remotion-hyperframes — Hybrid renderer: Remotion + Hyperframes (status: todo, access: 0)
    DECISION: Hybrid. Remotion (engine/ + projects/) renders premium 3D/parallax/glass/transition segments. Hyperframes CLI (Apache-2.0, free, local, built-in Whisper) renders LLM-authored + caption + audio segments. hybrid/render-hybrid.mjs orchestrates: render each segment with its engine -> normalize via ffmpeg -> concat into one MP4 (+ optional VO mux).
MCP: Remotion MCP installed (@remotion/mcp, stdio, no auth — docs-search). Hyperframes MCP skipped (HeyGen cloud, OAuth+credits) in favor of local 'npx hyperframes' CLI.
DEPS: ffmpeg 8.1.1 installed via brew (HF needs system ffmpeg; also powers the clean-audio.sh + Whisper align pipeline).
PROVEN: prototypes/hf-prototype/out (4.2MB, rendered 18.8s) + projects/kavach-premium/out (8.1MB) + hybrid/out/kavach-hybrid.mp4 (9.9MB, 41.5s, 60fps).
RATIONALE: keep mature Remotion (sunk cost, 3D + transition libs) + gain HF's LLM-native authoring + free Whisper, without migrating.
SOURCES: research 2026-06-16; HF v0.6.100 Apache-2.0; Remotion v4 freemium
[decision] decision.video-director-skill-agent — Generic output = structure failure; ship Director skill+agent (status: todo, access: 0)
    DECISION: Generic motion-graphics output is a STRUCTURE failure, not an animation failure (root cause: scenes animate containers with one flat fade and no through-line/hook/pacing). FIX: built a reusable Video Editing Director SKILL (~/.claude/skills/video-director/SKILL.md, ~11k) encoding all researched principles as an applicable rulebook + order-of-operations + anti-generic checklist, and a Director AGENT (~/.claude/agents/video-director.md, sonnet) that applies the skill: understand subject -> write SHOT-LIST SCRIPT first -> run checklist -> write Heroic-engine spec (sections/beats/dense keyframes >=4 props/transitions/camera/color-arc) -> verify. ENFORCED RULE: every hero element animates >=4 properties with >=2 keyframes, entrances overshoot (ease:back), NEVER a single flat fade. Source: research.video-storytelling-principles. STATUS: skill + agent registered (confirmed in available-skills list). NEXT: invoke the agent to direct the kavach-ad 2-min spec.

[decision] xml-script-source-of-truth — Script is XML (XSD-validated cinematography contract) compiled to spec.ts (status: todo, access: 0)
    PROBLEM: Markdown SCRIPT.md let shots be vague -> generic/slideshow; script had no enforced detail. DECISION: script becomes SCRIPT.xml validated by script.xsd; schema makes per-shot detail MANDATORY (reject if missing): exact in/out frames+duration, shot-size, every animated property as keyframes+easing, camera focus+zoom+path, continuity-in & continuity-out motion vectors, VO+timing, emotion, through-line. Compiler engine/src/script/compile.ts reads validated XML -> GENERATES spec.ts. Single source of truth; script and render cannot drift. Markdown retired for scripts.
[decision] engine-2.5d-layer-stack — 2.5D layer stack: a beat composites N layers at depths under one camera (status: todo, access: 0)
    Beat.layers?: Layer[] {scene,depth,parallax?,transform?,keyframes?,id?}. Stage3D already does CSS-3D perspective+perspectiveOrigin(camera)+translateZ; BeatStage now renders each layer at translateZ(depth*parallax) under the SHARED camera -> near layers (negative depth) parallax more than far (positive), the researched AE/Remotion 2.5D model (sources: aejuice, motionarray, Adobe layer-depth, reactvideoeditor parallax-pan). depth convention: negative=foreground/near, positive=background/far, 0=focal plane. Backward compatible: no layers => single depth-0 layer = old behaviour. Lint extended: sweptBox runs per-layer, clamps each independently (scaleLayer/shiftLayerPosition). engine tsc exit 0. This is what gives the camera depth to move THROUGH -> kills the flat-slide look at the source.

    engine/src/script/compile.ts + engine/compile-script.mjs CLI. Pipeline: (1) xmllint --schema (XSD structure gate) (2) compileScript semantic gate enforcing 12 motion principles XSD cannot: depth>=2 distinct, layer stagger (not all enterFrame 0), hero>=3 channels (secondary animation), no all-linear hero (easing), anticipation+settle frames present, arcs on diagonal moves, cut-on-beat integer (fps*60/bpm), readOrder references real layers (staging) (3) emit layered VideoSpec. [decision] continuous-event-timeline-model — Video model = continuous event timeline (elements on absolute frames), not shots (status: todo, access: 0)
    DECISION (user chose): replace shot/beat sequencing with a persistent stage + elements[] stream. Each Element: {id, scene, enterFrame, exitFrame (absolute timeline frames), depth, transform?, keyframes (frame-relative to enterFrame), enter/exit transitions}. Many elements live simultaneously (6-10), staggered every 10-20f, overlapping in waves; camera runs continuously over the whole runtime. Engine: add Timeline {durationInFrames, elements[]} to VideoSpec (alongside sections for back-compat); Player mounts each element inside a Sequence(from=enterFrame, duration=exit-enter) on ONE Atmosphere+camera stage, each in its own Stage3D at its depth. Lint sweeps each element window. Schema (XML) re-modeled: <timeline> with <element from=.. to=.. depth=.. scene=..> children carrying tracks. This is how Linear/Vercel/Apple ads work; no card sits alone => not a slideshow. Supersedes 17-shot model (pattern shot-granularity-is-slideshow).

[decision] xml-strict-alignment-timeline — XML strict alignment for timeline: grid anchors + no-overlap + keyframe/transform conflict ban (status: todo, access: 0)
    ROOT GAP (user): the strict XML schema was for the SHOT model; the dense timeline ad was authored DIRECTLY as spec.ts, bypassing all XML alignment enforcement -> radial-fan collapse + overlaps shipped unchecked. FIX: re-model script.xsd around <timeline><element from to depth anchor> and enforce 3 alignment rules in compiler (compile.ts) so misalignment FAILS to compile, not silently clamps: (1) GRID ANCHORS: elements declare position by named anchor on 12col x 6row safe grid (center/top-left/c3r2...) NOT raw x/y; compiler resolves anchor->snapped in-bounds coords; raw x/y = compile error. (2) NO-OVERLAP: sweep every element box x every frame; same-depth-band pair IoU>0.2 at any frame = compile error (the 6-card collapse would be rejected). (3) CONFLICT BAN: element with BOTH transform.position AND a position keyframe = compile error (the exact bug that collapsed the fan). Compiler emits timeline VideoSpec. Supersedes shot-model XSD. Engine timeline model already proven; this wires the strict gate to it.
[decision] strict-timeline-alignment-proven — Strict XML alignment for timeline PROVEN — grid anchors + conflict ban + no-overlap reject misalignment at compile (status: todo, access: 0)
    BUILT + PROVEN: projects/kavach-ad/timeline.xsd (anchors-only, no raw x/y, no position track) + engine/src/script/grid.ts (12x6 title-safe grid, resolveAnchor/enterStart/footprint) + engine/src/script/timeline-compile.ts (R1 grid anchors, R2 position-track ban=one position source, R3 per-depthBand box sweep every frame, reject IoU>0.2) + engine/compile-timeline.mjs CLI (xmllint XSD gate -> alignment gate -> emit spec). PROOF: clean 6-store-on-distinct-anchors timeline -> compiles (8 elements, no overlaps); two stores on SAME anchor c2r2 -> REJECTED '[overlap] s-decisions & s-research IoU 1.00 @frame 98'. The radial-fan-collapse bug class now FAILS to compile. engine tsc 0; emitted spec lints 0 err. Closes the gap: the dense ad bypassed the shot-XSD; now the timeline has its own strict XSD+compiler. Loopholes: malformed=N/A resolveAnchor throws on bad anchor (grid.ts); boundary=N/A enterTrack Math.min/max clamps frames; overlap=the WHOLE POINT, enforced; conflict=R2 buildAnimTracks throws on position channel.

[decision] beat-detect-shipped — Offline beat/BPM detection shipped (engine/beat-detect.mjs) — pure DSP, octave-corrected, proven on known-BPM click tracks (status: todo, access: 0)
    Built the BUILDABLE slice of the audio card. engine/beat-detect.mjs: pure-DSP offline beat detection. Pipeline: onsetEnvelope (per-hop RMS energy -> half-wave-rectified flux, FRAME 1024/HOP 512) -> estimateBpm (autocorrelation of envelope, peak lag in 60-180 BPM band, BPM=60*(sr/hop)/lag) -> detectBeats (anchor=strongest onset, beatTimes=anchor +/- k*period across signal). OCTAVE CORRECTION: autocorrelation favors slow tempi; when peak BPM<100 and the double-tempo (half lag) is in-band with ACF>=40% of the slow peak, prefer the double (librosa-style). synthClickTrack helper generates a known-BPM impulse train for testing WITHOUT an audio file/decode dep. VERIFIED: all 7 known BPMs (90/100/120/128/140/160/174) detected within 3 BPM; beat-spacing=period; empty signal safe; ZERO Math.random (deterministic). BUG-FIX on-sight: initial octave heuristic had inverted threshold (compared fast-lag ACF vs the slow peak it loses to) -> corrected to 40% absolute floor, 128 went 63.8->126.05. HONEST SEAM: mp3/wav DECODE needs bun add v1.3.7 (ba426210)

installed audio-decode@3.10.2

54 packages installed [4.62s] (CLI shell catches its absence, fail-closed); algorithm proven on synthetic PCM, not a decoded MP3 (no fixture). NOT shipped (still architecturally blocked): stereo PAN (Remotion <Audio> has no pan prop) + music DUCKING (cross-track analysis).
[decision] decision.yaml-scalar-coercion — YAML scene-prop numeric coercion at the compiler boundary (status: todo, access: 0)
    BUG CLASS FIXED AT ROOT. timeline-compile.ts buildScene() copied scene props verbatim (scene[name]=value), so a quoted YAML numeric like strokeWidth: "6" flowed through as a STRING into the Scene type's number field — tsc TS2322 at the generated spec.ts. The engine-only typecheck never caught it because the PROJECT was never typechecked against the engine types until the render harness was wired. ROOT CAUSE: no coercion layer between untyped YAML scalars and typed Scene numeric fields (strokeWidth/radius/sides/innerRadius/count). FIX: added coerceScalar(value) in timeline-compile.ts — numeric-string -> number ONLY when value.trim()!=='' && Number.isFinite(Number(value)), else left as-is. This guards the Number('')===0 / Number(' ')===0 footgun and leaves hex colors (#00d4ff -> NaN) and enum words (ellipse) as strings. Also unquoted the YAML instance (strokeWidth: 6). Recompiled spec.ts from corrected source (not hand-patched). Verified: both engine+project tsc clean; POC also recompiles; no digit-only string label at risk today. RESIDUAL (boundary lens): a future all-digit label like '2024' would be numified — correct long-term fix is per-field schema-typed coercion, not string-guessing; deferred (no such field exists). Source: https://www.squash.io/how-to-check-if-a-string-is-a-valid-number-in-javascript/

[decision] decision.pre-render-audio-mix — Pre-render audio toolkit: constant-power pan + sidechain duck (offline DSP feeding Remotion a stereo asset) (status: todo, access: 0)
    UNBLOCKED the audio pan/duck card. Remotion 4.0.478 <Audio> has volume + toneFrequency (pitch) but NO pan prop and NO render-time WebAudio node hook (verified remotion.dev audio docs this turn). The sanctioned workflow is to PRE-MIX offline and hand Remotion a finished stereo asset. Built engine/audio-mix.mjs (pure deterministic DSP, no new deps): panGains/panStereo = constant-power -3dB pan law L=cos(theta*pi/2) R=sin(theta*pi/2), L^2+R^2=1; duckMusic = sidechain ducking with TWO-STAGE topology (fast peak-detector decides VO presence + slow musical attack/release on the gain) — fixed the classic bug where a slow-releasing detector keeps the gate open so music never recovers; writeWavPcm16 = minimal RIFF/WAVE writer (clamps overshoot, no int16 wrap); channelData() = runtime-robust audio-decode channel extraction (getChannelData OR _channelData OR channelData) — fixed a getChannelData-is-not-a-function crash that existed in BOTH audio-mix.mjs AND beat-detect.mjs under Bun; reuses onsetEnvelope from beat-detect for the VO sidechain. Proof: engine/audio-mix.test.mjs 24/24 pass (pan law, stereo energy split, duck attenuate+recover, WAV header, overshoot clamp, determinism) + end-to-end CLI pan/duck on real WAVs emits valid stereo/mono files + beat-detect still decodes through the shared path. Sources: remotion.dev/docs/audio, Ableton constant-power pan law, sidechain envelope-follower DSP.

    The kavach-ad render had no audio because (a) the YAML had no audio field, (b) the schema meta block is additionalProperties:false, and (c) the compiler assembled the spec from a fixed meta field list and never read musicSrc — so even adding it to YAML would be dropped. Wired the full path in 4 edits: (1) timeline-compile.ts TimelineDoc.meta gains optional musicSrc?/audioSrc?; (2) compiler spec-assembly conditionally spreads ...(meta.musicSrc ? {musicSrc} : {}) so an audio-less spec stays clean; (3) timeline.schema.json meta.properties adds musicSrc/audioSrc (string minLength 1) so strict validation accepts them; (4) kavach-ad.yaml meta gains musicSrc: kavach-bed.wav. Player already resolves staticFile(audio/<musicSrc>) at volume 0.18. [decision] decision.strict-overlap-lint — Strict no-overlap lint: real per-scene footprint, all-bands, zero-overlap (status: todo, access: 0)
    ROOT CAUSE of on-screen overlap: the compiler no-overlap gate was structurally too weak in 3 ways: (1) it grouped pairs by depthBand and only compared WITHIN a band, so cross-band center-stacks (bg/ring/title/cta all anchor center, different bands) were NEVER checked; (2) threshold was IoU>0.2, allowing visible overlap below 20%; (3) the box model was footprint(size)=1920*0.6*size x 1080*0.5*size, a flat heuristic that does NOT match rendered pixels — investigation found only `shape` honors size; every text/card scene renders at HARDCODED px (kinetic fontSize 130, title 110, stamp 120, gateCard width 520, dbNode circle 120) and ignores size. FIX: new engine/src/script/scene-box.ts maps (sceneType,size,props)->REAL on-screen box matching the renderer. Rewrote the gate to: check ALL pairs ACROSS ALL bands (depth = z-order only, never licenses a collision), reject ANY intersection (OVERLAP_MIN_PX=64 tolerance), with full-frame backdrops (lightSweep/background/atmosphere) as the sole exemption (designed to sit under content). PROOF: engine/overlap-lint.test.mjs 10/10 pass (catches the exact cross-band center-stack, allows far-apart anchors, exempts backdrops, allows disjoint-lifespan same-anchor, sceneBox sanity). Fixed kavach-ad.yaml: ring moved center->bottom-right size 0.5->0.22 so it clears the center title/cta. kavach-ad now compiles with 0 overlaps; engine tsc clean; audio-mix test still green. Sources: SVG bounding box + collision AABB intersection (standard 2D geometry).
